name: Paramatrix Technologies Ltd
about: Founded in 2004, Paramatrix Technologies offers software applications and technology solutions for large and medium-sized companies.[1]
keyPoints:
Digital Transformation Services:[1][2][3]
INSIGHT: An integrated platform for data consolidation, analysis, MIS, and reporting tailored for the Banking and Capital Markets sectors.
PERFORM: A performance management platform for evaluating employee performance against predefined targets.
EPPM: Enterprise framework for project and program management, focusing on task scheduling and resource allocation.
PACE: Middleware framework for rapid application development, emphasizing business logic and reducing peripheral tasks.
ITCS: A compliance system for managing employee share trading, ensuring adherence to regulations like those from SEBI.
DROANA: A virtual classroom platform for online education, offering course scheduling, resource management, and assessment tools.
EVENTJET: A log monitoring and management solution capturing and analyzing event logs in near real-time.
BULWARK: A cloud security posture assessment tool providing rapid evaluations and detailed security insights.
PLAYMITY: A gamification platform for enhancing employee performance through leaderboards, AI-driven feedback, and incentives

cons: Company has a low return on equity of 11.9% over last 3 years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
Earnings include an other income of Rs.4.44 Cr.
